d:
Iyer’s Tamil newspaper features his inspirational interview as a village boy turned scientist, but everyone in Gokuldham receives the wrong newspaper. After running around the society—from Sodhi's house to Taarak's and finally to Jethalal's—Iyer finds his paper, only to discover the interview page missing.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
